description: Get or set the playback speed of the window the user is watching. Call with no arguments to read the current rate. Pitch is corrected by default, so speech stays natural — see the `pitch` CLI command to turn that off.

rate.description: Speed multiplier between 0.01 and 100 (e.g. 1.5). Omit to read the current rate.

relative.description: Treat `rate` as an offset from the current speed instead of an absolute multiplier. Clamped to the valid range.

name: set_speed
